integrity: Self-contained exact arithmetic and finite-group enumeration; no independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed groups of the abstract line–tritangent incidence graph only, over finite fields of characteristic at least five; not a theorem of Neron component groups or existence of every type over each field. Historical priority is provisional.
title: All 25 Weyl-type Frobenius-fixed graph Jacobians of cubic-surface lines and tritangents
